question: ABCD is a quadrilateral in which AB || DC, and E and F are the mid points of the diagonals AC and BD, respectively. If AB = 28 cm, BC = 15 cm, DC = 40 cm, and AD = 9 cm, then what is the length (in cm) of EF?
solution:
Given:

ABCD is a quadrilateral in which AB ∥ DC.

E and F are the midpoints of the diagonals AC and BD

AB = 28 cm 

CD = 40 cm

AD = 9 cm

BC = 15 cm

Concept used: The length of the line joining midpoints of the diagonals is half the difference of the length of parallel sides of the trapezium. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b4e6fce85c101a007d6296c90eb7637d232aff43236a255e2f07a99ea17d9f7.png] 

Calculation:

ABCD is a quadrilateral in which AB ∥ DC.

E and F are the midpoints of the diagonals AC and BD

We know that, the length of line joining midpoints of the diagonals is half the difference of the length of parallel sides of the trapezium.

So,

⇒ EF =(Difference of its parallel sides)

⇒ EF = (DC - AB)/2

⇒ EF = (40 – 28)/2

⇒ EF = 12/2

⇒ EF = 6 cm

∴ The value of EF is 6 cm
